meta.title: A sweet land of desserts from around the world
meta.description: Dessert Land is a global shop introducing and selling desserts from around the world, available in 10 languages.

hero.tagline: A sweet land where desserts from every corner of the world gather, introduced and sold in 10 languages.

manifesto.text: From the sweetness of a milkshake to the char of a Basque cheesecake, every bite holds the time of a place. We seek out the world’s desserts and bring them to you in your own language.

zoom.title: A world in every slice
zoom.body: The closer you look, the more stories you see. We share the ingredients, the origins and the craft.

world.title: A journey through world desserts
world.lede: Travel sideways through the sweetness of each country.

product.notice: Product details and prices are demo examples.

milkshake.name: Milkshake
milkshake.lede: Cold, thick and overflowing with joy.

cheesecake.name: Cheesecake
cheesecake.lede: Dense or scorched, an hour of rich cream cheese.

muffin.name: Muffin
muffin.lede: The warmth of morning, risen high.

pancake.name: Pancake
pancake.lede: Stacked high, with syrup running down.

creamcake.name: Fresh cream cake
creamcake.lede: Soft sponge, light cream and strawberries.

classic.name: World classics
classic.lede: From tiramisu to baklava, the taste of a nation.

footer.tagline: Dessert Land is a demo shop presenting the world’s desserts in 10 languages.

freakshake.name: Freakshake
freakshake.description: Born in Canberra: a chocolate shake piled high with cream and chocolate.

vanilla-malt.name: Vanilla malt shake
vanilla-malt.description: An American soda-fountain classic: vanilla ice cream, toasty malt and chocolate syrup.

new-york-cheesecake.name: New York cheesecake
new-york-cheesecake.description: New York’s signature dessert: dense, smooth and rich with cream cheese.

basque-cheesecake.name: Basque burnt cheesecake
basque-cheesecake.description: From San Sebastián: scorched on the outside by high heat, creamy within.

blueberry-muffin.name: Blueberry muffin
blueberry-muffin.description: An American muffin packed with juicy blueberries and dusted with icing sugar.

bran-muffin.name: Morning bran muffin
bran-muffin.description: A Canadian café breakfast staple: nutty bran with gentle sweetness.

maple-pancake.name: Maple pancakes
maple-pancake.description: A thick stack of pancakes drenched in Canadian maple syrup.

forest-berry-pancake.name: Forest berry pancakes
forest-berry-pancake.description: Inspired by Swedish summer forests, topped with tart berries and syrup.

strawberry-shortcake.name: Strawberry shortcake
strawberry-shortcake.description: The icon of Japanese patisseries: fluffy sponge layered with cream and strawberries.

saeng-cream-cake.name: Korean fresh cream slice
saeng-cream-cake.description: A favorite of Korean neighborhood bakeries: mildly sweet milk cream and soft sponge.

fraisier.name: Fraisier
fraisier.description: A French patisserie spring cake, walled with halved strawberries.

tiramisu.name: Tiramisu
tiramisu.description: Italy’s signature dessert of coffee-soaked biscuits, mascarpone and cocoa.

pastel-de-nata.name: Pastel de nata
pastel-de-nata.description: Portugal’s treasure: crisp pastry filled with rich custard, baked until blistered.

baklava.name: Baklava
baklava.description: Türkiye’s masterpiece: layers of thin pastry, pistachio and syrup.

black-forest-cake.name: Black Forest cake
black-forest-cake.description: Germany’s famous cake: layers of chocolate sponge, whipped cream and cherries.

egg-tart.name: Cantonese egg tart
egg-tart.description: A snack raised alongside Cantonese tea culture, known for its silky egg custard.

advisor.title: Which dessert is for you?
advisor.lede: Tell us your mood or taste, and we’ll pick from desserts around the world.
advisor.label: Describe what you’d like
advisor.placeholder: e.g. Something not too sweet to go with coffee
advisor.empty: Describe what you’d like or pick at least one taste.

advisor.limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a minute.
advisor.notice: Recommendations are for reference only. If you have allergies, always check the product’s allergen information. Your text is sent to an AI service to make recommendations, so please don’t include personal information.
